summary.text: Greg Cranford is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Mark Hollo (R).
Cranford was the Democratic nominee for North Carolina House District 89 in 2018, 2020 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Greg Cranford graduated from Newton-Conover High School in 1977 and from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 1981, according to information he submitted to Ballotpedia in 2018.
Cranford ran for North Carolina House of Representatives District 89 in 2018, 2020 and 2024, and incumbent Mitchell Setzer defeated him in each general election.

In a 2018 Ballotpedia survey, Cranford listed his top priorities as expansion of Medicare and health care for all, recruitment of high-paying, low-skilled, union-friendly jobs and employers, and elimination of standards and standardized testing in public schools.
